grades.reason: Mixed-size RVWMO litmus tests. They say nothing about FENCE.I or instruction-fetch synchronization across harts.
It only says RVWMO does not formally describe FENCE.I and points to Chapter 5. It gives nothing about whether FENCE.I affects other harts.

grades.quote: Moved FENCE.I out of the mandatory base and into a separate extension, with Zifencei ISA name. FENCE.I was removed from the Linux user ABI and is problematic in implementations with large incoherent instruction and data caches. However, it remains the only standard instruction-fetch coherence mechanism.
grades.reason: Changelog note that FENCE.I moved into Zifencei and is the only standard instruction-fetch coherence mechanism. It does not say whether the fence is local to one hart or covers all harts, so it gives only background.
Covers memory-ordering PMAs for main memory and I/O regions. It does not mention FENCE.I or instruction-fetch synchronization across harts.
